# keepsake
## Comprehensive Project Summary

### 1. Introduction

keepsake is an AI-powered cinematic storytelling project that explores the forgotten traces of human exploration on Mars. It focuses on the spacecraft components, landing systems, and engineering equipment that were essential to successful Mars missions but remained scattered across the Martian surface after completing their intended functions.

When people think about space exploration, they usually remember the astronauts, rovers, spacecraft, and scientific discoveries. However, behind every successful mission, there are numerous engineering components that make the journey possible. Some of these components are released, separated, or left behind during different stages of the mission, becoming permanent reminders of humanity's attempt to explore another world.

keepsake brings attention to these overlooked objects and transforms them from ordinary pieces of engineering hardware into the central subjects of compelling visual stories.

The project particularly focuses on NASA's Mars 2020 Perseverance mission, examining the different components involved in transporting the rover through the Martian atmosphere and delivering it safely to the surface.

Project Details – Echo of Memories

1. Project Name

keepsake

2. Project Category

AI-Powered Cinematic Storytelling / Space Exploration / Educational Visual Content.

3. Project Description

keepsake is an AI-assisted visual storytelling project that explores the forgotten remains of human space exploration on Mars.

The project focuses on the spacecraft components and landing equipment left on the Martian surface during NASA's Mars missions, particularly the Mars 2020 Perseverance mission.

Through cinematic visuals, AI-generated scenes, animation, and scientific storytelling, the project transforms these abandoned objects into the central characters of a collection of short visual narratives.

4. Main Theme

The central theme is the legacy of exploration and the stories behind objects that completed their missions but remained on Mars.

The project explores the idea that even the smallest components of a space mission have an important role in achieving extraordinary scientific milestones.

5. Project Scope

The project consists of six individual video concepts, each focusing on a specific object, component, or event related to Mars exploration.

The main subjects include:

  • Mars 2020 Backshell.
  • Mars 2020 Parachute.
  • Perseverance Heat Shield.
  • Mars 2020 Aeroshell.
  • Entry, Descent, and Landing (EDL) systems.
  • Other significant remnants associated with the Perseverance landing sequence.

The final six subjects should be confirmed against the project's actual asset list.

6. Target Platform

The content is designed primarily for digital platforms, including:

  • Instagram Reels.
  • TikTok.
  • YouTube Shorts.
  • Digital exhibitions and presentations.
